# Mark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Mark>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A brand / sign / name / logo that can be trademarked — the thing a [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md) protects ([schema:Brand](https://schema.org/Brand)). An information object: it may itself bear a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) (logos are also copyright works).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the brand, sign, name, or logo itself — the information object a [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md) protects ([schema:Brand](https://schema.org/Brand)), and which may also bear its own copyright as a creative work.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating the mark (the sign) with the trademark (the right over it — [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md)) and avoid using it for an arbitrary product name with no brand role.

### How to use

- Mint one [`Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md), carry its word form with [`gmeow:markText`](../properties/gmeow-markText.md), and link the right over it with [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkMark.md) from a [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md); co-type or attach a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](gmeow-RightsStatement.md) when the logo is also a copyright work.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatMark a [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md); [`gmeow:markText`](../properties/gmeow-markText.md) "Blackcat Informatics".
